title: Ordered affine diagonal coordinates and presented integration
statement: For a scheme Y and d≥0 use the ordered affine tower X→Y of [def-sbc-affine-space]. Construct the differences p₂*x_i−p₁*x_i in its self-product, their unique diagonal-ideal lifts and degree-one homogeneous classes on the actual normal cone [def-pur-normal-bundle]. These give the displayed normal coordinates. The product y coordinates and translated y−x coordinates give isomorphisms over X, the latter taking the diagonal to zero. In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], construct the presented integration transpose from the ordered counit [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], the canonical coefficient and compact-support comparisons [def-amb-vector-integration], and the counit-transposed dualizing base-change map [def-pur-co-smoothness]. Construct integration by the inverse exceptional Hom bijection, the ordered root-power comparison and normalized Tate restriction. All these are the existing explicit constructions, relocated without changing their data.
